sources.title: China Unicom Jing-Jin-Ji south-zone DC1 and DC2 M&O report
sources.publisher: Beijing TravelSky Birun Technology Co., Ltd.
sources.attribution: Beijing TravelSky Birun Technology Co., Ltd.
sources.summary: Participating certification consultant reports the September 9 south-zone DC1/DC2 ceremony and completed management/operations assessment of the operating facilities.
sources.date_semantics: September 9 is the explicit ceremony and company-declared article date; used as contemporaneous confirmation of an operating south-zone project, not first opening, certification grant date or completion date. Image storage paths contain September 17; original publication availability is not independently established. Badge expiry is June 16, 2028 and does not establish award day.
sources.public_api_discovery: Article HTML directly calls /index.php/news_list/findById with its public id=181; raw API includes full dated article. Company is a named direct project participant, not the operator.
sources.primary_source_scope: Direct participant report on its own certification consulting engagement.

sources.title: Named China Unicom Jing-Jin-Ji digital technology park area, OSM way 1263404569
sources.summary: Named mapped data-center Phase1 area supplies a representative campus marker; its tag is not lifecycle evidence.
sources.date_semantics: Mapping timestamp March 17, 2024 is an edit date, not a physical-status observation.
sources.coordinate_crs: WGS84 longitude/latitude supplied by OpenStreetMap API

sources.title: CSCEC reports Jing-Jin-Ji park south-zone construction completion
sources.publisher: China State Construction Engineering Corporation / China Construction Third Engineering Bureau
sources.attribution: China State Construction Engineering Corporation / China Construction Third Engineering Bureau
sources.summary: Contractor identifies the south-zone project at Gaocun Technology Innovation Park, Wuqing, Tianjin, with about 104,000 sqm and six structures including data-center, power-center and substation buildings.
sources.date_semantics: Article reports March 29, 2024 civil completion; historical identity/context only, not the fresh status anchor.

sources.title: Uptime Institute China awards registry: Jing-Jin-Ji DC1 and DC2
sources.summary: Certifier independently lists China Unicom Smart Technology Industry Co., Ltd. DC1 and DC2 in Tianjin, each holding M&O Stamp of Approval.
sources.date_semantics: Undated live registry corroborates certification and facility identity; retrieval is not an operating observation or award date.

sources.title: Tianjin Unicom reports north-zone civil works completion
sources.summary: Operator-authored report distinguishes the previously operating south zone from north-zone construction and later MEP. North planned IT load 108MW is out of scope for the south-zone addition.
sources.date_semantics: January 20 is report date; north civil completion described only as recent. Neither an exact completion day nor current north operating status is inferred.
